$comment: Market Street Railway (and, in 1909, United Railroads) lines as Manley's report of February 1, 1909 and O'Shaughnessy's of May 1929 give them, street by street in today's names: transit_pipeline.street_routes cuts them into shared street segments and writes each line's route. A stretch with `running` is in only that report's route.

Back toward Lake St. Manley (1909): "to Fulton to 6th Ave. and return", the loop No. 24 ran the other way ("Lake to 6th to Fulton to 8th to Clement to 6th", p. 16)
